Priya (People Ops): Heads-up — contractor Ethan R starts Mon remote. Needs loaner Mac, YubiKey, S3 staging read, and short phish-sim pause for onboarding lunch. Who can help?

Ethan R: Hi all — I don't have corp hardware yet. Also need access to the internal eval repo and the staging bastion.

Grace (Manager): Approving phish-sim pause for Monday lunch through EOD Monday. Non-prod only for S3.

Zoe (Security): Ok — security rules: contractors get no KMS admin rights. We can grant a time-limited decrypt role and S3 read-only. For phish exemption, please file the exemption form so it's auditable.

Tom (IT): We have loaner Mac available. Process: 1) loaner form https://redwood.internal/it/loaner 2) we'll pre-enroll MDM and include YubiKey 3) ship next-day if requested.

OnboardBot: Reminder: Security 101 must be completed within 5 business days — https://learn.redwood/sec101

Ethan R: Thanks. Quick Qs: how do I get SSH access? and where do I add my public key?

Zoe (Security): Use the bastion flow: add your pubkey to the onboarding ticket or run the provisioning script in infra/onboarding. We'll add temporary role staging-decrypt-ethan expiring in 72h.

Tom (IT): I'll put the bastion host in the MDM profile and push the dev cert bundle. If MDM fails run:

```
sudo profiles renew -type enrollment
```

and ping me.

Priya (People Ops): Actions: loaner request filed, phish exemption form link sent to Grace, Zoe to create temp role, Tom to ship device and YubiKey. Welcome Ethan! :tada:

Ethan R: Appreciate it — watching for tracking email and checklist.
